NAME: NetworkManager-wifi
DESCRIPTION: is what makes wifi work at all. It is a SEPARATE subpackage that a Fedora minimal install does not include, so without this line a laptop has no wireless after reboot.

NAME: linux-firmware
DESCRIPTION: provides most firmware blobs the kernel loads at boot. Note it does NOT cover Intel wifi -- see the three rows below.

NAME: iwlwifi-mvm-firmware
DESCRIPTION: is Intel wifi firmware (AX200/AX201/AX210/AX211/BE200 and similar). linux-firmware recommends Atheros, Broadcom, Realtek and MediaTek firmware but NOT this, and nothing else in the dependency graph pulls it, so on a minimal install an Intel wifi card simply does not appear. It also pulls iwlwifi-mld-firmware for Wi-Fi 7 parts.

NAME: iwlwifi-dvm-firmware
DESCRIPTION: is Intel wifi firmware for older chips (4965, 5000 and 6000 series).

NAME: iwlegacy-firmware
DESCRIPTION: is Intel wifi firmware for the 3945 and 4965 generation.

NAME: microcode_ctl
DESCRIPTION: applies CPU microcode updates. It lives in the comps standard group, not core, so a minimal install has none.

NAME: alsa-ucm
DESCRIPTION: provides the ALSA use-case configs that modern SoundWire and SOF laptops need. Without them the speakers stay silent even though a sink exists.

NAME: pciutils
DESCRIPTION: provides lspci, which is how you find out what hardware you have when the machine is offline.

NAME: usbutils
DESCRIPTION: provides lsusb, for the same reason.

NAME: alsa-sof-firmware
DESCRIPTION: is the audio firmware nearly every laptop made since 2019 needs. Without it there is no sound at all.

NAME: xorg-x11-server-Xorg
DESCRIPTION: is the X server, the display server itself.

NAME: xorg-x11-xinit
DESCRIPTION: provides startx, which begins the graphical session.

NAME: xorg-x11-xauth
DESCRIPTION: handles the X authority cookie that startx requires.

NAME: xorg-x11-drv-libinput
DESCRIPTION: is the input driver. Without it X starts with no keyboard or mouse.

NAME: mesa-dri-drivers
DESCRIPTION: provides the DRI graphics drivers X needs in order to render.

NAME: xsetroot
DESCRIPTION: sets the root window name, which is how dwm draws its status bar.

NAME: xset
DESCRIPTION: adjusts X server preferences such as the keyboard repeat rate.

NAME: xprop
DESCRIPTION: queries window properties and is used to find the focused window.

NAME: xwininfo
DESCRIPTION: reports window geometry, used by the screenshot scripts.

NAME: xrandr
DESCRIPTION: manages monitor layout, resolution and DPI.

NAME: xrdb
DESCRIPTION: loads the Xresources colour and font settings.

NAME: setxkbmap
DESCRIPTION: sets the keyboard layout.

NAME: xkeyboard-config
DESCRIPTION: supplies the keyboard layout definitions themselves.

NAME: xdotool
DESCRIPTION: scripts X input and is used by the unicode picker and by remaps.

NAME: xclip
DESCRIPTION: reads and writes the X clipboard from the command line.

NAME: xcompmgr
DESCRIPTION: is a lightweight compositor, giving transparency without tearing.

NAME: unclutter-xfixes
DESCRIPTION: hides the mouse cursor while you are typing.

NAME: arandr
DESCRIPTION: is a graphical front-end for arranging monitors.

NAME: feh
DESCRIPTION: sets the desktop wallpaper.

NAME: brightnessctl
DESCRIPTION: controls display backlight brightness.

NAME: polkit
DESCRIPTION: handles privilege escalation for graphical programs.

NAME: lxpolkit
DESCRIPTION: is the polkit AUTHENTICATION AGENT, and without it the polkit daemon above can never actually ask you anything. sysact (super+shift+q) calls 'systemctl poweroff -i', whose polkit action is auth_admin_keep, so with no agent running shutdown, reboot, suspend and hibernate all fail silently from inside dwm. polkit-gnome, which upstream guides suggest, no longer exists in Fedora. Autostarted from .config/x11/xprofile -- dwm has nothing that reads /etc/xdg/autostart.

NAME: dbus-x11
DESCRIPTION: provides dbus-launch and the X session bus integration.

NAME: dbus-tools
DESCRIPTION: provides dbus-update-activation-environment, which the session needs.

NAME: xdg-utils
DESCRIPTION: provides xdg-open, which routes files to the right program.

NAME: alerque-libertinus-fonts
DESCRIPTION: is the main serif typeface used throughout.

NAME: fontawesome-fonts-all
DESCRIPTION: provides the icon glyphs used in the status bar.

NAME: dejavu-sans-mono-fonts
DESCRIPTION: is a widely compatible monospace font.

NAME: google-noto-sans-mono-fonts
DESCRIPTION: covers monospace glyphs that Dejavu lacks.

NAME: google-noto-color-emoji-fonts
DESCRIPTION: renders colour emoji in the terminal.

NAME: google-noto-emoji-fonts
DESCRIPTION: is the BLACK-AND-WHITE emoji font, and it is not optional. dwm's drw.c excludes colour fonts when searching for a fallback glyph (FcPatternAddBool FC_COLOR FcFalse), so with only the colour font installed every status bar icon silently renders as nothing while the numbers still show.

NAME: neovim
DESCRIPTION: is the text editor that everything defaults to.

NAME: zsh-syntax-highlighting
DESCRIPTION: colours commands in the shell as you type them.

NAME: man-db
DESCRIPTION: provides the manual page reader.

NAME: groff
DESCRIPTION: typesets the LARBS guide. The mom macros are not in groff-base.

NAME: bc
DESCRIPTION: is the calculator bound to ctrl-a in the shell.

NAME: unzip
DESCRIPTION: extracts zip archives.

NAME: lynx
DESCRIPTION: is a terminal web browser, used to render pages as plain text.

NAME: fzf
DESCRIPTION: is the fuzzy finder used for file and history search.

NAME: bat
DESCRIPTION: is a syntax-highlighting file viewer used in previews.

NAME: atool
DESCRIPTION: lists and extracts archives of many formats.

NAME: mediainfo
DESCRIPTION: reports media file metadata in previews.

NAME: poppler-utils
DESCRIPTION: extracts text and thumbnails from PDFs.

NAME: highlight
DESCRIPTION: syntax-highlights files piped through less.

NAME: socat
DESCRIPTION: talks to the mpv IPC sockets so all players can be paused at once.

NAME: entr
DESCRIPTION: reruns commands when files change.

NAME: psmisc
DESCRIPTION: provides pstree and killall, which sysact and remaps depend on.

NAME: procps-ng
DESCRIPTION: provides free, pgrep and pkill for the status bar.

NAME: cronie
DESCRIPTION: provides crond itself. fedora.sh enables crond, but cronie is in the comps standard group, not core, so on the documented Minimal Install the unit does not exist and the enable silently fails into the log -- taking .local/bin/cron/checkup with it, which is what sb-dnfpackages depends on for its update count.

NAME: crontabs
DESCRIPTION: provides /etc/crontab and the run-parts wiring that cronie expects, and is likewise absent from core.

NAME: lm_sensors
DESCRIPTION: reads CPU temperature for the status bar.

NAME: bmon
DESCRIPTION: shows a live bandwidth graph.

NAME: htop
DESCRIPTION: is the interactive process viewer.

NAME: NetworkManager-tui
DESCRIPTION: is the terminal network manager, opened from the status bar.

NAME: dosfstools
DESCRIPTION: provides FAT filesystem tools for USB drives.

NAME: exfatprogs
DESCRIPTION: provides exFAT support for large USB drives.

NAME: ntfs-3g
DESCRIPTION: allows reading and writing NTFS partitions.

NAME: cryptsetup
DESCRIPTION: opens and closes LUKS-encrypted drives.

NAME: avahi-tools
DESCRIPTION: discovers network shares over mDNS.

NAME: cifs-utils
DESCRIPTION: provides mount.cifs, without which dmenumountcifs cannot mount a network share at all.

NAME: samba-client
DESCRIPTION: mounts SMB and NAS shares.

NAME: jmtpfs
DESCRIPTION: mounts Android phones over MTP.

NAME: gnome-keyring
DESCRIPTION: stores passwords and ssh keys for the session.

NAME: pinentry-gnome3
DESCRIPTION: prompts for GPG passphrases graphically.

NAME: libnotify
DESCRIPTION: provides notify-send, which every script uses to talk to you.

NAME: dunst
DESCRIPTION: is the notification daemon that displays those messages.

NAME: ImageMagick
DESCRIPTION: converts and inspects images from scripts.

NAME: chafa
DESCRIPTION: renders images as terminal glyphs, the fallback for file previews.

NAME: tesseract
DESCRIPTION: performs OCR on screenshots.

NAME: tesseract-langpack-eng
DESCRIPTION: is the English data that tesseract needs to do it.

NAME: zbar
DESCRIPTION: scans QR codes from the screen.

NAME: sox
DESCRIPTION: processes audio for the noise reduction script.

NAME: maim
DESCRIPTION: takes screenshots.

NAME: slop
DESCRIPTION: lets you select a screen region for maim to capture.

NAME: slock
DESCRIPTION: locks the screen. The Fedora build is already setuid, so it is not built here.

NAME: pipewire
DESCRIPTION: is the audio server.

NAME: pipewire-pulseaudio
DESCRIPTION: provides the PulseAudio interface on top of pipewire.

NAME: wireplumber
DESCRIPTION: is the pipewire session manager and provides wpctl.

NAME: mpv
DESCRIPTION: is the video player.

NAME: mpd
DESCRIPTION: is the music daemon that plays in the background.

NAME: mpc
DESCRIPTION: is the minimal command-line controller for mpd.

NAME: ncmpcpp
DESCRIPTION: is the full terminal interface for mpd.

NAME: sxiv
DESCRIPTION: is the image viewer. nsxiv was forked from it and shares its keybindings.

NAME: zathura
DESCRIPTION: is the document and PDF reader.

NAME: zathura-pdf-mupdf
DESCRIPTION: is the PDF rendering backend that zathura uses.

NAME: ffmpegthumbnailer
DESCRIPTION: generates video thumbnails for file previews.

NAME: transmission-daemon
DESCRIPTION: runs torrent transfers in the background.

NAME: transmission-cli
DESCRIPTION: is what td-toggle checks for before starting the daemon; Fedora splits it out from transmission-common.

NAME: transmission-common
DESCRIPTION: provides transmission-remote, which the scripts drive it with.

NAME: task-spooler
DESCRIPTION: queues downloads so that they run one at a time.

NAME: yt-dlp
DESCRIPTION: downloads video and audio from the web.

NAME: gtk2
DESCRIPTION: is the older GTK toolkit that some programs still need.

NAME: gtk3
DESCRIPTION: is the GTK toolkit that most graphical programs use.

NAME: gtk-murrine-engine
DESCRIPTION: renders the GTK2 half of the Arc theme.

NAME: qt5-qtstyleplugins
DESCRIPTION: provides the gtk2 Qt platform theme. .config/shell/profile exports QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=gtk2, and without this package every Qt program prints a 'could not find the Qt platform theme' warning and falls back to Fusion, so Qt applications ignore the Arc theme entirely.

NAME: arc-theme
DESCRIPTION: is the GTK theme. Arc-Dark replaces the Arc-Gruvbox used on Arch.

NAME: adwaita-icon-theme
DESCRIPTION: supplies the icon set.

NAME: lxappearance
DESCRIPTION: lets you change GTK themes and icons without editing files.

NAME: librewolf
DESCRIPTION: is the web browser, a hardened Firefox fork.

NAME: https://github.com/LukeSmithxyz/dwmblocks.git
DESCRIPTION: is the status bar.

NAME: https://github.com/lukesmithxyz/dmenu.git
DESCRIPTION: is the menu. This fork has the -P password flag that dmenupass requires.

NAME: https://github.com/lukesmithxyz/st.git
DESCRIPTION: is the terminal emulator.

NAME: https://github.com/lukesmithxyz/dwm.git
DESCRIPTION: is the window manager itself.

NAME: xcape
DESCRIPTION: makes a tapped capslock behave as escape. Vendored in vendor/xcape; upstream was deleted.

NAME: lf
DESCRIPTION: is the terminal file manager. Not packaged for Fedora, so it is built from source.

NAME: ueberzugpp
DESCRIPTION: draws real images in terminal file previews. Built from source.

NAME: pywal16
DESCRIPTION: generates a colour scheme from the current wallpaper.

NAME: pulsemixer
DESCRIPTION: is the terminal volume mixer opened from the status bar.
